Netcool/Impact (all versions): How is the Exit() action function expected to work with User Defined Functions?
Netcool/Impact (all versions)

Using the Exit() action function within a User Defined Function in a Policy will not exit the Policy process.
reference_evidence: This is because the Exit() parser function in IPL is designed to exit the immediate scope. To carry the action outside of the User Defined Function to the Policy level one would have to set a variable that is then tested immediately after the User Defined Function call

question: Can I apply a TIP 2.2 fix pack directly to a TIP 2.1 installation?
reference_evidence: In order to apply TIP 2.2 fix packs, the target TIP installation must already be at TIPCore 2.2.0 or newer. TIP 2.1 installations must be upgraded to TIP 2.2 using the TIP 2.2.0.1 feature pack.
